svg.title: Aura Logbook full-stack architecture
svg.desc: Left-to-right architecture: browser user, React and TypeScript frontend, .NET API, business services, repositories, active JSON data files, and Open-Meteo. SQLite and Dapper are declared package dependencies but are not wired to persistence. Five workflow cards run along the bottom.

g.text: SQLite + Dapper: declared, not wired to storage

svg.text: Solid arrows: runtime request / data flow · Dashed arrows: dependency / inheritance · Red/amber: security or external · Teal: external integration
